name: How long after cabinet installation can I use my new cabinets?

mainEntity.name: How long after cabinet installation can I use my new cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can typically start using your new cabinets immediately after installation is complete. However, if any finishing work, such as painting or sealing, was done on-site, it's important to allow adequate drying and curing time before heavy use to ensure the longevity of the finish. Our installers will advise you on any specific post-installation care or waiting periods, particularly concerning delicate surfaces or hardware adjustments. Generally, the structure is ready for immediate light use.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can generally use new cabinets right after installation. If finishes were applied, allow drying time as advised by installers before heavy use.
